titleEn: How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Surrey, BC? Real Timelines (2026)
titleZh: 素里浴室装修要多久？2026 年BC省素里真实工期指南
contentEn:
Planning a bathroom renovation in Surrey, BC in 2026? One of the most common questions homeowners ask 聚星装修 is how long the project will take. The answer depends on scope, permits, and whether your strata has approval requirements. Based on our actual 2024–2026 Surrey project data, here are the real timelines.

Small Bathroom Renovation (5–10 Days)

A guest bathroom refresh — new toilet, vanity, faucet, bath fan, and tile surround — typically takes five to ten working days for a Surrey contractor. This scope usually does not require a building permit in Surrey if you are not moving plumbing. Strata approval is not required for cosmetic-only work in most Surrey townhouse complexes. 聚星装修 completed a Newton-area townhouse guest bath on this timeline in October 2024.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from 聚星装修.

Standard Full Bathroom Renovation (2–4 Weeks)

Removing an old bathtub and installing a new walk-in shower, new flooring, updated lighting, and waterproofing takes two to four weeks. This scope requires a Surrey building permit for any plumbing modifications and typically requires strata approval in Surrey townhouse and apartment complexes. Permit processing time from the City of Surrey is typically 10 to 15 business days in 2026. Our team has completed several full bathroom renovations in Surrey neighbourhoods including Fleetwood, Newton, and Cloverdale within this timeline.

  • Demonstration and disposal: 2–3 days
  • Plumbing and electrical rough-in: 3–5 days
  • Waterproofing and tile work: 4–7 days
  • Fixture installation: 2–3 days
  • Final inspection and punch list: 1–2 days

Large or Custom Bathroom (4–8 Weeks)

A luxury master bathroom with curbless shower, heated floors, double vanity, and custom millwork takes four to eight weeks. This scope always requires a Surrey building permit and may require an electrical service upgrade if you are adding high-amperage features. Strata approval is mandatory in most Surrey apartment and townhouse complexes. In 2025, 聚星装修 completed a Fleetwood-area master bath with heated floors and curbless shower within six weeks — the longest single item was the custom glass shower door, which required a three-week lead time from a Lower Mainland supplier.

Factors That Can Extend Your Timeline in Surrey

Three factors most commonly push a Surrey bathroom renovation beyond its base timeline. First, permit delays — the City of Surrey building division averaged 10–15 business days for plumbing permits in 2025; factor in extra time if your project requires an electrical or structural permit alongside plumbing. Second, pre-approval in strata buildings — Surrey has a high proportion of townhouses and apartments where strata council review adds four to six weeks before work can begin. Third, specialty materials — custom tile, imported fixtures, and made-to-order vanities can require eight to twelve weeks of lead time, pushing your overall project back even if construction itself stays on schedule.

Surrey Bathroom Renovation Costs 2026

Timeline and budget go hand in hand. Based on 聚星装修' actual Surrey projects completed in 2024–2026, here are typical cost ranges:

These ranges reflect actual project costs in Surrey neighbourhoods including Newton, Fleetwood, Cloverdale, and South Surrey. Prices vary based on material selections and whether structural or plumbing work is involved.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Surrey?

For cosmetic work such as replacing a toilet, vanity, and faucet without moving plumbing, a Surrey building permit is generally not required. If your project involves moving drains, adding new plumbing lines, or altering electrical wiring, you need a permit from the City of Surrey. Permit applications can be filed online through Surrey's eApply portal and typically take 10 to 15 business days to process.

How long does a strata approval take in Surrey?

Surrey has a high concentration of townhouses and apartments where strata council approval is required before renovations begin. Strata approval typically adds four to six weeks to your project timeline. Begin the strata approval process before applying for your building permit so both tracks run in parallel where possible.

What is the average cost of a bathroom renovation in Surrey in 2026?

A standard full bathroom renovation in Surrey ranges from $18,000 to $35,000 based on 2024–2026 project data from 聚星装修. Luxury master bathroom renovations with custom tile, heated floors, and high-end fixtures typically cost $40,000 to $90,000 or more depending on material selections.

Can I live in my home during a bathroom renovation in Surrey?

Yes. For single-bathroom homes, contractors can typically complete work in phases so you retain use of at least one toilet and sink. For two-bathroom homes, 聚星装修 can renovate one bathroom at a time while you continue living in the home. In townhouse and apartment complexes, working hours in Surrey are typically restricted to Monday through Saturday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, as specified in most strata bylaws.

What is the most common delay in Surrey bathroom projects?

The most common delay is waiting for the City of Surrey building permit, which averaged 10–15 business days in 2025. Specialty material lead times — particularly for custom shower glass, imported tile, and made-to-order vanities — are the second most common cause of timeline extensions. 聚星装修 orders all long-lead materials at the start of the project to keep construction on schedule.

在BC省素里（Surrey）计划进行浴室装修？房主向聚星装修最常问的问题之一是项目需要多长时间。答案取决于工程范围、许可证要求，以及您的共有权益公寓（strata）是否需要审批。基于我们2024年至2026年的实际素里项目数据，以下是真实工期。

小浴室装修（5至10天）

客用浴室翻新——更换马桶、洗手台、水龙头、浴霸和瓷砖墙——通常需要五到十个工作日。此类工程范围在素里一般不需要建筑许可，前提是不移动管道。在大多数素里联排别墅项目中，也不需要strata审批。聚星装修曾在2024年10月在牛顿（Newton）地区完成了一个联排别墅客用浴室，耗时在此范围内。

标准全浴室装修（2至4周）

拆除旧浴缸并安装步入式淋浴间、新地板、更新照明和防水工程，通常需要两到四周。此类工程范围需要素里建筑许可（用于任何管道改造），在素里的联排别墅和公寓大楼中通常也需要strata审批。素里市2026年的许可处理时间通常为10至15个工作日。我们的团队曾在素里多个社区完成过全浴室装修，包括Fleetwood、Newton和Cloverdale。

  • 拆除和清理：2至3天
  • 管道和电气粗装：3至5天
  • 防水和瓷砖工程：4至7天
  • 装置安装：2至3天
  • 最终检查和收尾：1至2天

大型或定制浴室（4至8周）

配备无障碍淋浴间、地暖、双洗手台和定制木作的豪华主人套房浴室，通常需要四到八周。此类工程范围始终需要素里建筑许可，如果要添加大功率设备，可能还需要电气服务升级。2025年，聚星装修曾在素里Fleetwood地区完成了一个配备地暖和步入式淋浴间的主人浴室，耗时六周——耗时最长的单项是定制玻璃淋浴门，需要从低陆平原供应商处等待约三周。

可能延长素里工期的因素

三个因素最常导致素里浴室装修超出基础工期。第一，许可延误——素里建筑部门2025年管道许可平均处理时间为10至15个工作日；如果您的项目同时需要电气或结构许可，还需额外时间。第二，strata审批——素里有很高比例的联排别墅和公寓，strata委员会审核在工程开始前需要额外四到六周。第三，特种材料——定制瓷砖、进口五金和订制洗手台可能需要八到十二周的交货时间，即使施工本身保持进度，也会拉长整体工期。

常见问题

素里浴室装修需要许可证吗？

对于不移动管道的 cosmetic 工程（如更换马桶、洗手台和水龙头），通常不需要素里建筑许可。如果您的项目涉及移动排水管、添加新管道线路或更改电线，则需要素里市政府的许可。许可申请可通过素里eApply门户在线提交，通常需要10至15个工作日处理。

素里strata审批需要多长时间？

素里有大量联排别墅和公寓，需要strata委员会批准后方可开始装修。strata审批通常为项目工期增加四到六周。在申请建筑许可之前就开始strata审批流程，使两个流程在可能的情况下并行进行。

2026年素里浴室装修的平均成本是多少？

根据聚星装修2024至2026年的项目数据，素里标准全浴室装修成本范围为$18,000至$35,000。配备定制瓷砖、地暖和高端五金的豪华主人套房浴室通常在$40,000至$90,000或更高，具体取决于材料选择。

装修期间我可以住在家里吗？

可以。对于单浴室住宅，承包商通常可以分阶段完成工作，以便您至少保留一个马桶和水槽的使用权。对于双浴室住宅，聚星装修可以一次装修一间浴室，同时您继续住在家里。在联排别墅和公寓大楼中，素里的工作时间通常限制在周一至周六上午8:00至下午5:00，正如大多数strata附例所规定。

素里浴室项目最常见的延误是什么？

最常见的延误是等待素里市政府建筑许可——2025年平均处理时间为10至15个工作日。特种材料交货时间——特别是定制淋浴玻璃、进口瓷砖和订制洗手台——是工期延长的第二大原因。聚星装修在项目开始时就订购所有长交货期材料，以保持施工进度。
